paper_title: Extended Search for the Invisible Axion with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX cavity haloscope excludes DFSZ axion-photon coupling over 2.66-3.31 ueV (680-790 MHz), 90% CL. Exclusion presented only as a plot (Fig. 4) with no numerical table; the paper states DFSZ couplings are excluded across the range. Emitted data points are DFSZ-line g_agamma values computed from f_a via m_a=5.70 ueV(1e12 GeV/f_a) and g_agamma=(g_gamma*alpha)/(pi*f_a) with g_gamma=0.36 — approximate. Some mode-crossing gaps (Table I) are excluded from limits.
